in_marathi.name: Radheya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Worshipper of Radha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Radheya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Radheya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Radhya' which means 'worshipper of Radha'. Radha is the consort of Lord Krishna in Hindu mythology. Therefore, the name Radheya symbolizes devotion and love for God.
